parsed.rationale: The lead II rhythm strip is irregularly irregular with no discernible P waves and a fibrillatory baseline, which fits AF. The ST elevation in V1-V3 sits on deep rS/QS complexes, a pattern that can be a normal variant or reflect old anterior infarct, and it does not meet STEMI criteria.
